feeds.title: Phyllis Burchett Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hey there, I'm Phyllis! Get inspired and learn some photography tips and tricks through my blog! Check out equine and animal photos from my travels plus my photography workshops or retreats. Additionally, I love sharing my passion for photography and art with other photographers. You can frequently find me leading Equine Photo Tours to Iceland, and hosting workshops throughout the country from the beaches of Florida to the ranches of Montana.

feeds.title: Maria Marriott Blog
feeds.description: In my blog, I share everything about my photography sessions in the wild and about the conditions of the horses that live there. Hi! I'm Maria Marriott. I am compelled to use my skill as a photographer to share with you what I have seen and to bring awareness to the issue these majestic creatures currently face the ever-present threat to their safety and freedom. My hope is that my work will invite you to wonder, imagine, dream and smile. That you will be inspired to get out and experience the beauty that is the American Wild.

feeds.title: Reversed Eye Photography Blog
feeds.description: Catch up on the latest news with Reversed Eye Photograph's Blog! From sessions and horse shows to the ins and out's of photography, there is always something new to read here and always plenty of beautiful images from recent sessions! Beautiful images from a Calgary equine photographer! Reversed Eye Photography is a small local photography business in the Calgary Area. It is run by Annakah Stadlwieser and caters to equine photography.

feeds.title: Ciara Doone Rush Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Ciara Doone Rush. I'm a horse lover and creative at heart and feel incredibly lucky to be able to do something every day which I feel so passionate about! Welcome to my Horse Photography Blog. I hope you enjoy looking through some of my favorite stories that I have been able to capture. I will guide you through your Photo Shoot Experience so you can feel as comfortable & confident as possible as we create a set of stunning images for you to treasure for a lifetime.

feeds.title: Ride the Sky Equine Photography Blog
feeds.description: Read and view recent equestrian, horse, and pet photography work on the blog by Ride the Sky Equine Photography. Hi! I'm Betsy, a Certified Professional Photographer Capturing Beautiful Horses & the Equestrians that love them. I bring you an equine photography portrait experience customized to you and your horse. Ride the Sky Equine Photography isn't just for horses, though we love them dearly. We also provide a custom portrait experience for pets and the people who love them.

feeds.title: Copper Arrow Photography Blog
feeds.description: Click here now to see all the latest news about equine photography sessions that are shot by the top equine photographer only at Copper Arrow Photography! Hi, I'm Aubray, I'm a passionate equestrian photographer, with a love of traveling, and an admirer of the nostalgia of the past. I want to create memories that can connect generations, something tangible that can be passed down and appreciated for years. The images I strive to create will let you remember the joyous times spent with precious family members and beloved equines.

feeds.title: Learn with Kirstie Marie Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Kirstie Marie. I built my dream business, and now I am here to help you build yours. I share tips, information, and guides on how you can become a professional equine photographer. I offer mentoring services to other photographers and small business owners. I also have my own on-demand courses for photography which can help you become a great photographer.

feeds.title: Shelly Williams Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Shelly Williams, a photographer specializing in weddings, high school seniors, and equines. Find all of my equine photography sessions in one place, which is in my blog. I help my clients to gain confidence, and pride and create an experience that they love. My goal during each session is to make my clients so comfortable that they feel like they're posing themselves. Feel free to browse to find your favorite photos.

feeds.title: Kirstie Marie Photography Blog
feeds.description: Kirstie Marie is a lifetime horse enthusiast and has experienced first-hand the bond between a horse and a girl. She strives to capture that special relationship for every client. In her blog, she shares all the information about the tools to help you reach your goals and have fun along the way.

feeds.title: Shelley Paulson Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hello Horse Lover! I'm a horse lover too and I'm so glad you stopped by! I am based in Minnesota but travel far and wide taking photos of horses, creating videos, and sharing all this information through my blog to help you grow as an equestrian photographer. I spend time creating, captivating, rich, story-filled images for equestrian businesses, brands, and publications. I also provide education and mentoring for equine photographers, sharing what I have learned in my 18 years of building a photography business.

feeds.title: Ashleigh Magnus Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Ashleigh Magnus. Explore my blogs to know more about horse and rider photography, fine art, weddings, or education for photographers here. My goal is to capture real, authentic relationships and memories. Specializing in equestrian, engagement, and wedding work, I strive to create an experience you will cherish for years to come.

feeds.title: Terri Cage Photography Blog
feeds.description: A collection of many of the photo sessions I have done for high school seniors, equestrian, stallion shoots, and much more. May also include some photography tips and a few personal posts. I am constantly learning new techniques on the use of light and how to improve photography and at the same time sharing it with you all so that you can take the best pics that need no editing.

feeds.title: Fast Horse Photography Blog
feeds.description: Get insights about the horse photography sessions that I love to do with my clients, and catch all these amazing stories in my blog. Hi, I'm Cara Taylor Swift. As an equine portrait specialist, I help equestrians who enjoy time with their horses, run a horse-inspired business, or are cultivating an equine or equestrian-inspired brand. Fast Horse Photography captures the connection between horses and humans and celebrates the joy that they bring to our lives through portraiture, commercial photography, and fine art prints.

feeds.title: Karinda K Equine Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Karinda K, I'm an Equine Photographer and Educator that travels all over the world photographing horses and riders from all walks of life. Stay up to date with the latest equine photography, check out some of our clients, and read my 365 Days of Horses series! Let me help you build a highly profitable photography business that is true to you and what you believe in. A business that allows you to live the life of your dreams, and get the clients of your dreams.

feeds.title: Hannah Freeland Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Hannah Freeland, This blog is about all the photography sessions that I carry out with my clients and my personal experience of photography. I'm a Photographer specializing in equine lifestyle portraits and lifestyle commercial photography. Capturing the love and connection between you and your horse. Equine Lifestyle Portrait Photographer.

feeds.title: Amelia Hart Photography Blog
feeds.description: Stories from past photo shoots, style guides, and much more. Learn everything there is to know about my photo shoots here. Hi! I'm Amelia Hart, When you book a photoshoot with me, I strive to provide you with an unforgettable experience. I am extremely passionate about photography and horses, and ensure that this shows through every aspect of my work.

feeds.title: Dark Horse Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hey there! I am Courtney, the face behind Dark Horse Photography. I share all the amazing moments of sessions over here, capturing the pure bond between my clients and their horses. You deserve professional photos of you and your horse that expresses the love that you share, My goal is to help you capture that bond.

feeds.title: Truluck Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kristina. I'm a photographer based out of El Paso, Texas with a love of photographing the most important connection in the world that's between an equestrian and the horse that they love. I blog about all the photography sessions that I carry out and share my experience through them.

feeds.title: Rachel Griffin Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Rachel, an Oklahoma-based portrait photographer specializing in equestrians. Capturing the incredible partnership shared by passionate riders and their heart horses. I've spent years studying and perfecting how to pose equestrians of every age and size, and I pair it with my lifelong horse obsession to help both your horse and you look you're very best on camera. My goal is that you feel just like you do after an incredible ride, wholeheartedly in love with your horse and yourself.

feeds.title: Jo Hansford Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! We are Jo and Nic, THE husband-wife team behind Jo Hansford Photography. We travel across the globe doing the thing we love the most, horse photography. Here we share all information about every photography session that we do and also share some knowledge on horse photography.

feeds.title: Shannon Castaneda Photography Blog
feeds.description: Get all information about the horse photography business, marketing, and photography session here in my blog. Hello everyone! My name is Shannon and I am an equine photographer based out of Jacksonville, Florida. I launched Shannon Castaneda Photography in 2019 and am honored to create photos that will be treasured for a lifetime!

feeds.title: Dakota Grown Photos Blog
feeds.description: Sharing everything about the wild horses of Theodore Roosevelt National Park in North Dakota through photos, videos, and stories. Want to know everything about wildlife horse photography? then we strongly recommend you to follow our blog! Dakota Grown Photos is one place for everything you want to know about horse photography.

feeds.title: Catherine Michele Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hey, y'all! Welcome to my blog. I'm Catherine! I'm an equine and senior photographer based in beautiful Coastal Virginia. My mission is to give equestrians the one thing I wish I had, but can never get, professional portraits showcasing the relationship with their horse that will last for generations. Grab a cup of coffee or glass of wine and enjoy viewing my latest work, browsing resources for photographers & equestrians, and getting a peek into my life. So go on to the blog mate!

feeds.title: Laura Fiddaman Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Laura Fiddaman, a professional photographer. In my blog, I share tips and tricks for horse photography, riding, and about horses. I will be there every step of the way helping you to achieve exactly what you want, and I can't wait to see what we can create. If you have a horse or dog that is everything to you, why not get in touch now and make a start.

feeds.title: Terise M. Cole Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm terise! I share all of my photography session experiences through my blog. I serve the photography needs of equestrians all over New England and beyond, specializing in portraiture and event coverage. My goal is to capture every moment from the start to the end of your session - perfect or not.

feeds.title: Elizabeth Hay Photography
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Elizabeth Hay. I love photographing the relationship between a horse and rider because it is one that I understand very well. Hanging out in the barn and photographing a rider and their horse is at the top of my list. Here I share information about the experiences that I had in each and every session. Follow my blog to stay updated!

feeds.title: Lindsey Long Blog
feeds.description: I blog about my photography sessions with my clients and I share my experience of horse photography here. Hi! I'm Lindsey Long. I provide Southern California equestrians with beautiful images of their beloved horses, capturing the human-equine bond. I also write photograph stories for reputable equine media. I compete in the low adult jumpers and also have a regular blog column in the Chronicle of the Horse where I reflect on my equestrian journey.

feeds.title: Mariah Farmer Photography Blog
feeds.description: A blog about horses and equine photography in Fayetteville Arkansas. Hi! I'm Mariah, an equestrian photographer specializing in horse pictures and equestrian photography. Whether I am capturing a special bond with your equine partner or senior pictures, I aim to capture your unique personality and portraits that you will enjoy for years to come.

feeds.title: Julie Cordero Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Julie Cordero, Our lives with our pets make unique and fun stories. Follow along with the stories of my clients. I also share tips and ideas about horse photography and also share experiences of every photography session I do. I create custom artistic portraits of your furry, scaly, or feathered friends, and their people too.

feeds.title: Leah Lewis Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Leah Lewis. My purpose is not to just snap a few pretty pictures of you and your horse. It is to visually express the story of your bond together, capture the in-between moments and forever preserve them. I love to share stories about the photoshoot session I do. If you are excited and interested in photography and horse you should definitely read my blog.

feeds.title: Half Steps Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Lexi Stapleton. A photographer who gets it: the roller-coaster journey of being an equestrian. Here I blog about the horse photoshoot that I do with my clients expressing the relationship between horses and humans. My goal is to capture photographs that do that for you. Photographs that lift you up and remind you why you do this crazy thing on those hard days.

feeds.title: Steven Quon Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Steven, an Equestrian Video & Stills Photographer based in Calgary. In my career, I made mistakes along the way and I learned a great deal. And now, I want to share everything I've learned with you so that you can become a better photographer/videographer without wasting your time trying to piece things together on your own. My main goal is to help you unlock your potential, identify roadblocks, address your challenges, and much more.

feeds.title: Wild Horse Photo Safaris
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jennifer Rogers, a professional photographer and photo tour guide here in Western Utah. In my blog, I share information related to wild horse Onaqui photography, conservation, and a lot about how they live their life in the wild. You can join me on safaris and learn more about photography directly from me! follow my page to know more.

feeds.title: Norfleet Marketing Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Kelsey, and I'm here to hype you up. The lessons I learned from over two decades in the horse industry have shaped the mindset of confidence and positivity to share my experience of photography with you through my blog. My goal is to tell your story with your heart horse. I offer one on one sessions to my clients and also do equine marketing for them.

feeds.title: Joanna Fair Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Joanna Fair, I'm an equine lifestyle and fine art portrait photographer. You must be having questions like....What should you wear on your photoshoot, Why should you have a photoshoot with your horse, What happens during your photo shoot with your horse? Don't worry! I have all your questions answered in my blog. you'll also get to know me a bit better as well! Dive into past photo shoots, information blogs, how I became an equine portrait photographer, and much more.

feeds.title: Roam Photos Blog
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Jackie Harris, an equine & pet photographer. This is a blog for dramatic equestrian and pet photography that reveals the unique beauty of the love between people and their horses and pets. My goal is to photograph your horse, dog, or pet, capturing their personalities, all the details that make them so beautiful and special to you, and to give you dramatic beautiful pieces of unique art so that you can feel their presence long after they are gone.

feeds.title: Hannah Cole Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Hannah Cole, a horse photographer. In this blog, I will share with you all my adventures, achievements and inevitable fails as I embark on another season of equestrian photography. My goal is to increase people's passion for horses as well as photography. Hop on to the website, Horse Lovers!

feeds.title: Molly Virginia Morris Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Molly. I am a California Central Coast-based photographer specializing in equine, agricultural, and western lifestyle imagery. Here I share stories about my equine photoshoots that I enjoy and love doing. Through my creative knowledge and practice, I strive to gift others with a tangible representation of the grit, craft, and personality of their passions. I also would like to hear about how you are contributing to our communities, & documenting the aspects and moments you most cherish.

feeds.title: Pony Portrait Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Pipa, a professional equine photographer, specializING in producing beautiful heirloom images of children and their ponies. In my blog, I share the stories of the cute photography session that I do with children and ponnies. My aim is to spread joy and happiness through my photos and blog.

feeds.title: Fiona Moore Photography Blog
feeds.description: West-Midlands Based Equine Photographer Documenting the life of being a Full-Time Equestrian Photographer. Blogging everything horse related & sharing the inspiring stories of my wonderful clients. Follow along for plenty of horse-talk & Photographs! In my horse photography session, I strive to put an emphasis on the relationship between you & your horse. Aiming to capture your Friendship as well as Your Horse's Personality.

feeds.title: Landry Major Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Landry Major. Here i share all information about different horse photography events and exhibitions that take place in and around. I also share updates about what's going on in the horse community. I'm a horse photographer myself and my work has been featured in The New York Times, Time Magazine, and other select publications. Want to know about horse photography in depth? Get on to the website.

feeds.title: Jackie Hancock Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jackie Hancock, an equestrian, Family and Pet, Commercial, and Wedding Photographer. In my blog, I share my experience of equestrian photography which I cover at different events that take place nationally and internationally. Follow my blog to know more about how to cover for official events that take place all around the world!

feeds.title: That Herd Blog
feeds.description: That Herd - Horses Being Horses is a photography blog archive about the lives of free-range and wild horses living in a natural environment. I hope to share what it feels like to experience that added surge of energy, the accelerated heartbeat, that tingling of nerves that indicates something in a wild environment has caught one's attention. This photo blog is an effort to fearlessly join my global community.

feeds.title: Lunar Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Imogen. I help horse-obsessed girls turn their memories into fun, vibrant photos that they can cherish them for life. Photoshoots are a fun way to capture those precious memories, so let's talk about how your dream photoshoot looks for you and start creating those beautiful, vibrant images that will be a constant reminder of happy times.

feeds.title: Hergott Photography Blog » Horse Photography Sessions
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Eva, I love taking photos and sharing how to do certain things. If you are interested in horse photography do not hesitate to check my tips & tricks. My main focus is on equine and canine photography. I also take one on one photography sessions with my clients capturing moments that you can cherish for life.
